# YouTube Summarizer with Gemini

> Summarize any YouTube video in one click using Google Gemini and your 100% customizable prompt. Free, lightweight, and open source Firefox extension with zero telemetry and zero server-side data collection.

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://epikaigle.github.io/gemini-youtube-summarizer/
- Firefox Add-ons (AMO): https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/gemini-youtube-summarizer/
- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/Epikaigle/gemini-youtube-summarizer
- License: The Unlicense (Public Domain / Open Source)
- Browser Compatibility: Mozilla Firefox (Desktop & Android)

## What the Extension Does
YouTube Summarizer with Gemini injects a native "Summarize" ("Résumer") action directly into YouTube:
1. Under the video player on watch pages (`/watch?v=...`).
2. Inside the three-dots context menu on every video card across the Home feed, Subscriptions, Channel pages, and Recommendations.

When the user clicks "Summarize":
1. The extension captures the normalized URL of the selected YouTube video.
2. It retrieves the user's custom instruction / prompt stored locally in `browser.storage.local`.
3. It opens Google Gemini in a new browser tab with the video URL and the customized prompt pre-filled and submitted automatically.

## Core Features & Differentiators
- **100% Customizable Prompt**: Unlike rigid competitors that force a single hardcoded prompt, users have total freedom to define their own instructions in options (e.g. 5 key takeaways, actionable outline, ELI5 explanation, full transcript analysis, or link only).
- **Native YouTube UI Integration**: The button matches YouTube's official design system (Light & Dark theme adapted, proper ripple effects, native icons).
- **Privacy First (Zero Data Collection)**: No analytics, no telemetry, no tracking, no intermediate proxy servers, no user accounts required. The prompt is stored strictly inside Firefox's local storage.
- **Direct to Gemini**: Works directly with Google Gemini without requiring any paid third-party API key.

## Technical Details
- Manifest Version: Manifest V3 (Firefox Gecko 140+)
- Permissions: `storage` (for local prompt preference)
- Content Scripts: Injected on `https://*.youtube.com/*` and `https://gemini.google.com/*`
- Internationalization: Supported in French, English, Spanish, and Chinese via `_locales` and dynamic web components.

## How to Install
- For Firefox users: Visit https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/gemini-youtube-summarizer/ and click "Add to Firefox".
- For developers: Clone https://github.com/Epikaigle/gemini-youtube-summarizer and load temporarily via `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`.
